118573.name: Mayan Yisroel
118573.note: IRS exempt-organization record (EO Business Master File, irs.gov, Nov 2026): 'CONGREGATION MERKAZ SHIUREI TORAH / MAYAN YISROEL' (EIN 41-2071394), 706 Eastern Pkwy Apt 4B, Brooklyn, ruling July 2003: the earliest record of it found, so the year by the filing rule (HANDOFF 4b; an IRS ruling can lag the start, so low). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (July 22 2004). Rabbi Yoseph Vigler, on COLlive (28 March 2011, 'Clip Promotes Mitzvah Share'): 'Five years ago we started in Flatbush and have Baruch Hashem grown in leaps and bounds'; 'Mayan Yisroel a Center for Chassidus and community organization in the Flatbush section of Brooklyn', so it came to Flatbush (now 3315 Avenue N) about 2006, from Crown Heights.

earlier.where: 706 Eastern Parkway, Crown Heights, Brooklyn (the address on its IRS record)

118176.name: Chabad Kesher Foundation
118176.note: IRS exempt-organization record (EO Business Master File, irs.gov, Nov 2026): 'FRIENDS OF KESHER FOUNDATION INC' (EIN 75-2666081), 6704 Starbuck Dr, Dallas, ruling May 1998: the earliest record of it found, so the year by the filing rule (HANDOFF 4b; an IRS ruling can lag the start, so low). Rabbi Asher Goldschmidt; its own About page (chabadkesherfoundation.com, a page chabad.org dates Nov 2009, read through WebFetch Nov 11) says only 'Rabbi Asher has been here 30 years.' Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (July 22 2004). To check: the Texas Jewish Post on The Portal to Texas History for its first mention.
